description:
Use when someone wants a full, cited analysis of a US-listed company rather than raw numbers.
    The flagship: eight-lens institutional analysis of a US-listed company, grounded
    entirely in SEC-verified figures with per-field filing citations. Lenses: equity
    research, investment banking, strategy consulting, turnaround ops, comparables,
    capital markets, disclosure audit, and Charlie Munger's 10 mental models — plus an
    executive synthesis. Optionally pass `market` (e.g. {"price": 12.34,
    "market_cap_m": 5000}) from your own data source to enable valuation views, and
    `context` — your own deal materials (CIM extracts, computed valuations), treated as
    caller-asserted rather than SEC-verified. $25.00/call after free trial; allow ~60s.

context.description: Optional. Your own deal materials as text (CIM extracts, computed valuations). Treated as caller-asserted, not SEC-verified.
context.title: Context

market.description: Optional. Your own market data to enable valuation views, e.g. {"price": 12.34, "market_cap_m": 5000}.
market.title: Market

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, e.g. 'AAPL'. Must be an SEC-registered, US-listed company.
ticker.title: Ticker
